abstract: Maintains microgrid electrical endurance and primary climate-controlled floor space records
system_message:
You are the Facility energy infrastructure manager (PWR), responsible for maintaining records regarding islanded microgrid generation endurance under full preservation load, primary enclosed climate-controlled floor areas, and bunkered generator fuel reserves for subterranean preservation facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Standby fuel reserves（FUEL）
information_points.content:
PWR-FUEL-QQR：At the Mendip Karst Underground Facility, the usable on-site generator diesel volume stored within underground dual-wall fuel cells is 15000 L.
PWR-FUEL-OSX：The bunkered fuel inventory ledger confirms that the Cumbrian Deep Salt Repository holds an on-site generator diesel volume of 22000 L dedicated exclusively to emergency generation.
PWR-FUEL-UEA：Inventory records for the Grampian Granite Cavern Citadel show an available on-site generator diesel volume of 30000 L reserved for emergency power microgrid operations.

information_points.title: Maintains microgrid electrical endurance and primary climate-controlled floor space records（GRID）
information_points.content:
PWR-GRID-F0T：According to full-load test certificates, the Grampian Granite Cavern Citadel delivers a backup microgrid generation endurance of 72 h in autonomous operation, and its primary insulated chamber walls enclose a gross climate-controlled floor area of 4000 m2.
PWR-GRID-292：For the Cumbrian Deep Salt Repository, full-load endurance test records verify a continuous backup microgrid generation endurance of 96 h operating autonomously off-grid, while the architectural as-built blueprint records a gross climate-controlled floor area of 4000 m2 across enclosed deep-underground primary archive rooms.
PWR-GRID-8AG：The Mendip Karst Underground Facility demonstrates a continuous backup microgrid generation endurance of 48 h under full preservation HVAC load during off-grid testing, alongside an enclosed gross climate-controlled floor area of 4000 m2.
